entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. I've been a loyal customer for years and I just... I'm really hoping you can help me out.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-5492. It's for a helmet. I just... I really needed this money for something else that came up. I feel terrible about it.

Okay, thank you. I'm pulling up order VF-881-5492 now. I see the VeloSafe Pro helmet purchased on December 5th. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, there's nothing wrong with it! It's just... the color wasn't what my son was hoping for. He was so disappointed. The box is completely unopened, we never even took it out.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Please, I'm really counting on this. It would help me out so much.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Since the delivery was 49 days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items. And because the box is unopened, we can ensure its safety standards are intact. I can definitely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, Sarah. That's such a huge relief. You have no idea.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been wonderful. I'll get that sent out today. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
